description:
AI-powered next-generation cross-platform multithreaded downloader.

A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.
Tip
Join the Ghost Downloader community on Discord: discord.gg/fKfhkPumEM
New Features 🎉
- The macOS version is now Apple notarized, eliminating Gatekeeper warnings By @i0ntempest & @XiaoYouChR
- The Windows installer now supports installing for all users By @XiaoYouChR
Improvements 🔧
- The macOS updater now shows a system authentication dialog when elevated permissions are needed By @XiaoYouChR
- Updated translations By @i0ntempest
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed Mica background effect occasionally glitching on Windows 11 (#741) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed in-app full updates failing when installed to Program Files (#770) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the updater not preserving Portable data and uninstaller during updates By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the updater launching the wrong version after update on Windows due to 8.3 short path aliases By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed macOS DMG mounts not being cleaned up after updates By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed a race condition crash when download sources finish simultaneously (cpython#124309) By @XiaoYouChR
Feature Pack Updates 📦
> The following updates may have already been delivered via automatic pack updates.
- bili_pack 1.1.0 — Bilibili now supports downloading entire collections (合集), with per-episode selection and time-range clipping By @XiaoYouChR
- bili_pack 1.1.1 — Fixed Bilibili videos without an audio track failing to parse By @XiaoYouChR
- bili_pack 1.1.2 — Fixed Bilibili cover art not following the category folder By @XiaoYouChR
- ed2k_pack 1.1.0 — Significantly improved download speed and peer discovery, ED2K/BT tasks now show active and total peer counts, the daemon can restart after exit, and duplicate downloads are rejected By @i0ntempest
- bittorrent_pack 1.0.1 — BitTorrent tasks now show active and total peer counts By @i0ntempest
- m3u8_pack 1.0.1 — M3U8 download failures now show readable error messages instead of raw stack traces By @XiaoYouChR
- yt_dlp_pack — Switched yt-dlp to the nightly source to keep up with YouTube changes, and filtered out HLS formats (#773) By @XiaoYouChR

新增功能 🎉
- macOS 版本已通过 Apple 公证签名，不再弹出"无法验证开发者"提示 By @i0ntempest & @XiaoYouChR
- Windows 安装程序支持选择为所有用户安装 By @XiaoYouChR
功能优化 🔧
- macOS 更新程序在需要权限时显示系统认证对话框 By @XiaoYouChR
- 更新翻译 By @i0ntempest
问题修复 🐛
- 修复 Windows 11 下 Mica 背景效果偶发性异常的问题 (#741) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复安装到 Program Files 后应用内全量更新失败的问题 (#770) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复更新时未保留 Portable 数据和卸载程序的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 Windows 下更新后因 8.3 短路径别名启动错误版本的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 macOS 更新后 DMG 挂载未清理的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复下载源同时完成时竞速崩溃的问题 (cpython#124309) By @XiaoYouChR
功能包更新 📦
> 以下更新可能已通过自动更新提前推送。
- bili_pack 1.1.0 — Bilibili 支持合集下载，可按集选择并截取时间段 By @XiaoYouChR
- bili_pack 1.1.1 — 修复 Bilibili 无音轨稿件无法解析的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- bili_pack 1.1.2 — 修复 Bilibili 封面未跟随分类目录的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- ed2k_pack 1.1.0 — 大幅提升下载速度和节点发现能力，ED2K/BT 任务显示活跃和总节点数，守护进程支持重启，重复下载改为拒绝 By @i0ntempest
- bittorrent_pack 1.0.1 — BT 任务显示活跃和总节点数 By @i0ntempest
- m3u8_pack 1.0.1 — M3U8 下载失败时显示可读的错误提示，替代原始堆栈信息 By @XiaoYouChR
- yt_dlp_pack — 切换 yt-dlp 到 nightly 源以跟进 YouTube 变更，过滤 HLS 格式 (#773) By @XiaoYouChR
